title: How Cleaning Up a Mess You Didn't Make Builds a Godly Man People Count On
caption:
The dishes in the break room. The spreadsheet nobody fixed. The trash everybody walked past.

Not your mess. Clean it anyway.

It kills the scorekeeper in you. It makes you the man people call first. It trains you for the bigger messes coming: a wife's bad week, a brother's crisis, a family that needs somebody to step in.

Jesus picked up the towel nobody assigned Him.

"Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men." Colossians 3:23

Save this and find one mess tomorrow.
